_about: The strict hand check of every automated main-set chain, criteria 1 to 7 of docs/multihop_plan_v1.md section 7, read by the builder on Oct 5, 2026. A chain fails on the first criterion it misses. The famous-decoy chains count against the bar at the automated stage whatever the check says; the reading is kept for the diagnosis.

tiger-king--joe-exotic--big-cat-public-s.note: House floor debate on the Big Cat Public Safety Act (Jul 28, 2022): 'the TV series Tiger King showed us that there is a dark and dangerous side to keeping lions, tigers, and other big cats in captivity. In fact, Joe Exotic from that series is in jail for violating the Lacey Act and the Endangered Species Act.' The member names Joe Exotic's conduct as the case for the bill, in the same breath as the series; attention to Joe Exotic rose after the release (onset Mar 31, 2020, p = .015). Signed Dec 20, 2022 (Pub. L. 117-243). Known positive K2.
titles: Attention to Joe Exotic surges after the release
Congress passes the Big Cat Public Safety Act; a member cites Joe Exotic in the floor debate

The member cites the drama itself to show the value of public service broadcasters; the Horizon scandal is not a reason for the Media Act.

Second reading of the Offences Bill (Mar 20, 2024): the bill 'will quash the convictions of those affected by the Post Office Horizon scandal' and clear the names of those 'whose lives were ruined because of the Horizon scandal'. The scandal is the Act's stated reason; attention to it rose 370-fold the day after the first episode. Known positive K1.
titles: Attention to the Post Office scandal surges the day after the first episode
The Offences Act quashes the Horizon convictions; the minister moving it names the scandal as its reason

sputnik--sputnik-crisis--european-space-.note: Sputnik 'precipitated the American Sputnik crisis' (Sputnik 1 article, lead). The European Space Agency article: 'In 1958, only months after the Sputnik shock, Edoardo Amaldi (Italy) and Pierre Auger (France) ... met to discuss the foundation of a common Western European space agency.' The link is reported by timing in the agency's own origin story, the weakest form of reported. The same article: ESA 'in its current form was founded with the ESA Convention in 1975, when ESRO was merged with ELDO.' New: the repository held NASA, ARPA, the NDEA and GPS for Sputnik, not ESA.
titles: The launch precipitates the American Sputnik crisis
Months after the Sputnik shock, two physicists begin planning a common European space agency; ESA forms in 1975
